maya (Partnerships): kicking off a tiny thread: propose a 'Starter -> Pro' ladder for marketplace offers that bundles HW rebates and SI activation credits. goal: faster proof-of-value, clearer renewal expectations, and a conversion path to Dedicated. thoughts?
aj (Sales): short answer: yes. need to map to quota/ACV. also: do we risk cannibalizing direct committed deals?
maya (Partnerships): we'll gate starter by $15k min commit over 90 days. pro is 12mo with true-up. no new SKUs; implement with marketplace pricing masks + entitlement flags.
liam (Product): call out dedicated interplay so infra/ops know: any HW rebate that can be redeemed for Dedicated should require capacity SKU mapping.
serena (Finance): flag: revenue recognition for 90-day prepayments and credits. onboarding credits applied as contra-revenue and amortized. I'll run ARR scenarios.
maya (Partnerships): draft tiers below:```
STARTER: 30% off MSRP, min $15k commit / 90d, onboarding credit $3k, SI activation credit $1.5k
PRO: 18% off MSRP, 12mo commit, quarterly true-up, onboarding credit $1k, HW uplift rebate up to $10k (redeemable only against Dedicated capacity purchases)
CONVERSION INCENTIVE: upgrade to Dedicated within 180 days -> 75% of onboarding credit returned as one-time service credit
CREDIT RULES: credits do NOT stack (highest applicable wins); SI activation credit requires signed integration checklist within 45 days
```
chirag (Solutions): SI enablement: we want a short checklist: integration runbook, test harness access, scoping doc, co-marketing asset sign-off. SI credit attaches after checklist validated.
kate (Legal): LOA for joint announce needs 10 business days lead + partner quote approval window. also require partner IP checkbox on the one-pager.
marketing-bot: FYI scheduled: draft partner blog template saved -> https://redwood.docs/marketplace/starter-pro-template (owner: marketing).
ops (Eng): ops items: entitlement flags in prod, sandbox pricing staging, billing-hook smoke tests, and telemetry to track credit redemptions. can run validation Weds AM.
aj (Sales): HW rebate: propose we fund via a 10% co-sell pool (from our margin) and add a 5% reserve to cover churn adjustments. Make rebate redeemable only when customer purchases Dedicated or Reserved blocks.
liam (Product): UI: show two price rows: "Intro price (Starter)" and "Renewal guidance (Pro)" with a tooltip explaining the renewal ladder and potential step-downs. include an FAQ link.
maya (Partnerships): launch/runbook timeline idea: T-6w assets drafted, T-4w partner LOA signed, T-3w enablement + demo env, T-1w legal signoff, public announce.
serena (Finance): action: I'll produce ARR scenarios for 3x churn sensitivity bands and confirm proration mechanics by Thu COB.
aj (Sales): one more: propose a renewal sweetener: if customer renews at >=110% consumption of commit, extend Pro discount for next year by 3ppt. helps retention.
maya (Partnerships): agreed. Action items: Maya finalize doc + runbook (due Tue), Serena ARR model + rev-rec note (due Thu), Chirag SI checklist (due Fri), Kate finalize LOA template (due Tue), Ops run sandbox validation (Wed). Any objections? :rocket:
